div.div: خَرْمٌ A prominence, or projecting part, of a mountain: (JK, S, K:) pl. خُرُومٌ. (JK.) And A bed trenched by a torrent (مَا خَرَمَ سَيْلٌ [see 1]): (JK:) so some say: (TA:) or a road in a [tract of high ground such as is termed] قُفّ; or on the summit of a mountain. (JK, TA.) [See also مَخْرِمٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
